answer_1.quote: Given a satirical image, we evaluate the model's satire understanding capability ... prompting the model to generate a textual description of each subimage ... and the punchline ...
answer_1.outputs: textual descriptions of left and right sub‑images and a generated punchline (why the image is funny/satirical)

answer_2.quote: We use lexical overlap metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE‑L, METEOR, and semantic similarity metrics such as BERTScore ...

answer_4.quote: Each image description is human‑evaluated based on the following (binary) criteria (1) Correctness (2) Appropriate Length (3) Visual Completeness (4) Faithfulness ...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judged descriptions on correctness, appropriate length, visual completeness, and faithfulness.
